thread:
mai: Kicking off a quick smoke for 'meridian-v3' with the new int6 quant kernels on staging. Heads up — already seeing weird locale-specific failures: Arabic bracket mirroring + missing furigana in JP outputs. Run: https://staging.redwood/run/12345

chen: Can you paste a minimal repro sample?

mai: Sure, two small examples (expected -> actual):
- Arabic (expected keeps order inside parentheses):
  expected: "المؤلف (يوسف)"
  actual:   ")فيوس( المؤلف"  <-- mirrored parentheses and internal characters shifted

- Japanese (expected preserves ruby furigana tags, actual drops them):
  expected: "東京〈とうきょう〉は美しい。"
  actual:   "東京は美しい。"  <-- furigana/ruby removed

liam: Interesting. If float16/float32 keep correct behavior then it's probably quant kernel or tokenizer->kvcache alignment after quantization. Did you compare token sequences?

mai: I dumped token ids for the Arabic sample: token seq differs around the opening paren. float16 tokens: [401, 2021, 78, 9001, 332] int6 tokens:   [401, 2021, 78, 9001, 332]  (ids look same)
So tokenization seems unchanged, but detokenized string drifts after quantized decoding step.

alex: Did you try running with the bidi postprocess off? Maybe kernel reorder interacts with RLMBidi optimizations.

mai: toggled bidi postprocess=false -> Arabic parity restored. JP furigana still missing though. So two separate failure modes?

chen: Could be two different fallouts of the same numerical instability in softmax/topk ordering. Int6 reduction might change sampling order near ties and that exposes some bidi/detok edge cases. Any kernel PRs recently?

liam: There's a kernel tweak merged yesterday that short-circuits KV-copy for small sequences (commit 0d4f2b9). It changes memcpy alignment on the streaming path. Might be relevant. Repro job: CI-job-4987 triggered. ops-bot: CI job 4987 started for staging on meridian-v3-int6 (link: https://ci.redwood/job/4987).

alex: Quick checklist: 1) reproduce on float16 (mailed earlier) 2) toggle bidi/detok 3) run with old kernel (pre-0d4f2b9) 4) check sampling RNG seed parity

mai: Done 1-2. float16 okay. toggling bidi fixed Arabic. Old kernel run pending (script below).

# run old kernel build
ssh staging-runner
cd /srv/inference/meridian-v3
./run_eval.sh --quant int6 --kernel-hash 0d3a9f1 --tests small-locale-suite

eva: Preliminary eval numbers from the smoke: ja->en BLEU -6.1 vs float16, ar->en BLEU -2.4 and chrF -3.2 on Arabic. Adding failing prompts to regression set now: /evals/regressions/meridian-int6-locales.txt

chen: If old kernel fixes it, we should pin kernel in deploy for int6 and run a bisect to find the exact line. I can bisect memcpy/align changes tomorrow.

liam: I'll also add a quick instrument to log decoder logits ordering around punctuation for the Arabic path. If sampling order flips, we should see near-equal logits.

mai: Thanks all. Action items: alex to run old-kernel job, chen to bisect memcpy change, liam to add logits trace, eva to add prompts to regression suite. I'll block meridian-int6 rollout until we confirm. :pray:

ops-bot: meridian-v3-int6 smoke -> blocked (deploy guard: locale-regression > threshold).
